TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**19 -> 2**17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128 -> 64 (grad_accum stays 1); all LRs and schedules untouched.

TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**19 -> 2**17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128 -> 64 (grad_accum stays 1); all LRs and schedules untouched.

DEPTH 8->10 (n_embd 512->640, 5 heads), TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**19->2**18, DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 (grad_accum 2) for VRAM headroom.
Two constants at depth 10: HEAD_DIM 128->64 (10 heads of 64, n_embd unchanged at 640) and WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5->0.3; nothing else.
HEAD_DIM 128->64 (10 heads of 64 at unchanged n_embd 640) plus MATRIX_LR 0.04->0.06; everything else untouched.

One constant: WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 1.0, so the LR plateau disappears and lrm = 1 - progress decays linearly to zero from step 0; time-average lrm 0.75 -> 0.50. Nothing else changed (HEAD_DIM 128, DEPTH 10, 2^18 batch, MATRIX_LR 0.04).
One constant: WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.7 at the unmodified depth-10 / HEAD_DIM 128 baseline; LR plateau ends at 30% of the budget instead of 50%, time-average lrm 0.75 -> 0.65. Nothing else changed.
EMBEDDING_LR 0.6->0.45, UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.004->0.003, MATRIX_LR 0.04->0.03, SCALAR_LR 0.5->0.375; schedule, HEAD_DIM 128, DEPTH 10, batch 2^18 all untouched.

One constant: Muon MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.028 (-30%) at the true baseline (HEAD_DIM 128, WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5, DEPTH 10, 2^18, device batch 64). Nothing else. val_bpb 0.988612 vs 0.988076 baseline: a tie, +0.0005.
Two constants: WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5->0.7 and WINDOW_PATTERN "SSSL"->"L", so all 10 layers get the full 2048 context instead of 7 of them seeing 1024; HEAD_DIM stays 128, nothing else changed.

Added ATTN_SCALE = 0.12 to the hyperparameter block and passed it as softmax_scale to fa3.flash_attn_func, replacing FA3's default 1/sqrt(head_dim) = 0.0884 at head_dim 128 (x1.357 on attention logits); nothing else changed.
One character in GPT._compute_window_sizes: short_window = long_window // 2 -> // 4, so the 7 'S' layers attend 512 tokens instead of 1024 (3 layers keep the full 2048); nothing else changed.
One value: _precompute_rotary_embeddings base=10000 -> 1000; nothing else changed. val_bpb 0.991196 vs 0.987227 baseline (+0.0040).
One constant: DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 -> 128, so the 2^18-token optimizer step is one fwd/bwd instead of two accumulated micro-steps; identical math, nothing else changed.

One string: WINDOW_PATTERN "SSSL" -> "SSSS", so layers 0-8 attend 1024 and only the forced last layer keeps the full 2048 context (was layers 3, 7, 9 global). short_window stays long//2; nothing else changed.
Two constants: short_window = long_window//4 (S layers attend 512 instead of 1024; 3 of 10 layers keep full 2048) and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64->128 so grad_accum goes 2->1 at the same 2^18 total batch.
One character in _compute_window_sizes: short_window = long_window // 2 -> // 8, so the 7 'S' layers attend 256 tokens instead of 1024; layers 3, 7, 9 keep the full 2048. Nothing else changed.
One argument: torch.compile(model, dynamic=False) -> torch.compile(model, dynamic=False, mode="max-autotune-no-cudagraphs"); identical math, nothing else changed.
Deleted one line in GPT.forward: 'logits = logits.float()', so the tanh softcap and F.cross_entropy run on bf16 logits; nothing else changed.
Two constants: short_window = long_window//4 (S layers attend 512 instead of 1024; 3 of 10 layers keep full 2048) and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64->128 so grad_accum goes 2->1 at the same 2^18 total batch.

Replaced the 5 per-layer value_embeds tables with a single nn.Embedding looked up once per forward and handed to the same alternating layers (net -4 lines); VE params 26.2M -> 5.2M, model 85.9M -> 64.9M, FLOPs/token unchanged.
One line: has_ve() returns True, so all 10 layers get a value-residual embedding + gate instead of 5; params 85.9M -> 112.1M, FLOPs/token unchanged.
One value: _precompute_rotary_embeddings base=10000 -> 100000; nothing else changed. val_bpb 0.981197 vs 0.981817 baseline (-0.00062, inside the noise floor).
